SOME OF THESE ROWS ARE DEFECTS, not acceptable behaviour: see docs/known-issues/jdk-only/the-first-jdk-21-run-found-the-javalangaccess-carrier-is-pinned-to-system-1-20260908.md and jdk-21-serialization-round-trip-returns-the-wrong-class-20260909.md. The vthreads rows are an intermittent race, so this set is the MAXIMAL one observed and was required to survive two consecutive gate runs before being accepted.
